name: runlater
description: Schedule HTTP requests from Codex: call any URL once at an exact time or on a cron schedule, with retries and a log of every run, through the RunLater remote MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Schedule HTTP requests and webhooks from your agent
interface.longDescription: RunLater calls any public URL at an exact time or on a cron schedule in your timezone, retries failures with backoff and logs every response. Ask Codex to call a webhook every weekday at 9am, run a job now, pause a schedule or check why last night's run failed. Sign in once with OAuth, no key to paste. Plans start at $15 a month with a 14-day trial.
defaultPrompt: Call this webhook every weekday at 9am Chicago time
List my schedules and show which ones are failing
Run the backup job now and show me the response
